#!/bin/bash
set -eo pipefail

# Product contract lane: one canonical Java engine, plus maintained code catalogue.
repo_root=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
cd "$repo_root"
mkdir -p target
cold_check_classes=$(mktemp -d "$PWD/target/cold-check-classes.XXXXXX")
cleanup_cold_check_classes() {
  if [[ -n "${cold_check_classes:-}" && -d "$cold_check_classes" ]]; then
    rm -r -- "$cold_check_classes"
  fi
}
trap cleanup_cold_check_classes EXIT

# Shared compact kernel-projection utility, not an alternate interpreter.
javac -J-Xmx256m -source 11 -target 11 -d "$cold_check_classes" research/lean-hosting/java/prototype/TypedLongMemo.java

echo "Running maintained canonical Java Lean engine contracts from one isolated jar"
javac -J-Xmx256m --release 11 -g -d "$cold_check_classes/java-ir-baseline" \
  modules/lean-jvm/src-java/ansatz/lean/jvm/internal/exec/Interpreter.java \
  modules/lean-jvm/src-java/ansatz/lean/jvm/internal/exec/ScalarBits.java \
  modules/lean-jvm/src-java/ansatz/lean/jvm/internal/exec/Utf8Bytes.java
jar cf "$cold_check_classes/java-ir-baseline.jar" -C "$cold_check_classes/java-ir-baseline" .
(
  cd research/lean-hosting
  clojure -J-Xmx384m -J-Xss8m -Sdeps "{:paths [\"src\" \"test\" \"$cold_check_classes\"]}" \
    -M research/java-ir-baseline/check-runner.clj "$cold_check_classes/java-ir-baseline.jar"
)

echo "Running maintained compact Java code catalogue producer contracts"
python3 research/lean-hosting/scripts/test-java-code-catalogue.py

echo "Legacy World wire/facade and Pattern experiments are optional: bin/run-lean-hosting-research-checks"
